```{python}
import spacy
from spacy import displacy
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
from nltk.corpus import wordnet as wn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import nltk
from wordcloud import WordCloud

nltk.download('wordnet')

eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
ita_nlp = spacy.load("it_core_news_sm")
fin_nlp = spacy.load("fi_core_news_sm")
spa_nlp = spacy.load("es_core_news_sm")

```

```{python}
#English read book
def read_book(path):
    with open(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
      return f.read()
  
eng = read_book("../data/english_alice.txt")
```

```{python}
#English lemmas
eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")

eng_doc = eng_nlp(eng)

eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower()) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#English Lemma Frequency
freq_eng = Counter(eng_lemmas)
```

```{python}
#English Top 20 Lemmas
eng_df = pd.DataFrame(freq_eng.items(), columns=["Lemma", "Frequency"]).sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
eng_df.head(20)

#Convert into dict because WordCloud doesn't take dfs
eng_dict = dict(zip(eng_df.head(20)["Lemma"], eng_df.head(20)["Frequency"]))
eng_dict
```

```{python}
#English WordCloud
eng_cloud = WordCloud(
    width=800,
    height=400,
    background_color="white"
).generate_from_frequencies(eng_dict)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.imshow(eng_cloud, interpolation="bilinear")
plt.title("English Alice Top 20 Lemmas")
plt.axis("off")
plt.show()

plt.savefig("english_cloud.jpeg", format="jpeg", dpi=300)
```

```{python}
#Part 4: Picking Lemmas

eng_nouns = ["rabbit", "key", "duchess", "cat", "tea"]

ita_nouns = ["coniglio", "chiave", "duchessa", "gatto", "tè"]

fin_nouns = ["kani", "avain", "herttuatar", "kissa", "tee"]

spa_nouns = ["conejo", "llave", "duquesa", "gato", "té"]
```

```{python}
def wordnet_info(word, lang):
    data = []

    for syn in wn.synsets(word, pos=wn.NOUN, lang=lang):
        data.append({
            "Word": word,
            "Synset": syn.name(),
            "Gloss": syn.definition(),
            "Hypernyms": [h.name() for h in syn.hypernyms()]  })
    return data
```

```{python}
#English
eng_data = []

for w in eng_nouns:
    eng_data.extend(wordnet_info(w, "eng"))
eng_df = pd.DataFrame(eng_data)
eng_df
```

```{python}
#Italian
ita_data = []

for w in ita_nouns:
    ita_data.extend(wordnet_info(w, "ita"))
ita_df = pd.DataFrame(ita_data)
ita_df
```

```{python}
#Finnish
fin_data = []

for w in fin_nouns:

```

Wup Scores for nouns and verbs

```{python}
#English
cat_syn = wn.synset("cat.n.01")
rabbit_syn = wn.synset("rabbit.n.01")

feel_syn = wn.synset("feel.n.01")
think_syn = wn.synset("think.n.01")

cat_rabbit_wup = cat_syn.wup_similarity(rabbit_syn)
feel_think_wup = feel_syn.wup_similarity(think_syn)

cat_rabbit_wup, feel_think_wup
```

```{python}
#Italian nouns
gatto_syn = wn.synsets("gatto", pos=wn.NOUN, lang="ita")[0]
coniglio_syn = wn.synsets("coniglio", pos=wn.NOUN, lang="ita")[0]

#Italian verbs
sentire_syn = wn.synsets("sentire", pos=wn.VERB, lang="ita")[0]
pensare_syn = wn.synsets("pensare", pos=wn.VERB, lang="ita")[0]

#Wup Scores
gatto_coniglio_wup = gatto_syn.wup_similarity(coniglio_syn)
sentire_pensare_wup = sentire_syn.wup_similarity(pensare_syn)

gatto_coniglio_wup, sentire_pensare_wup
```

```{python}
#Finnish nouns
kissa_syn = wn.synsets("kissa", pos=wn.NOUN, lang="fin")[0]
kani_syn = wn.synsets("kani", pos=wn.NOUN, lang="fin")[0]

#Finnish verbs
tuntea_syn = wn.synsets("tuntea", pos=wn.VERB, lang="fin")[0]
pitää_syn = wn.synsets("pitää", pos=wn.VERB, lang="fin")[0]

#Wup Scores
kissa_kani_wup = kissa_syn.wup_similarity(kani_syn)
tuntea_pitää_wup = tuntea_syn.wup_similarity(pitää_syn)

kissa_kani_wup, tuntea_pitää_wup
```
